summary: Oracle Corporation filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $10 billion primary common stock offering, alongside a separate but concurrent $10 billion senior notes offering; closing of each is not conditioned on the other. Shares trade on the NYSE under ORCL, last at $130.67 on October 30, 2026. Pricing is left blank, and BofA Securities serves as global coordinator and joint book-running manager with Wells Fargo, Citigroup, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan and others. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, dilution and the debt-equity funding mix.
